image_description: A small turtle, likely a juvenile mud or musk turtle, walking on a rough asphalt surface. The turtle has a dark, high-domed carapace with visible orange/red markings along the marginal scutes and plastron area. Its skin is dark grey/brown with a rough texture. The head is extended, showing a pointed snout. The limbs are visible, appearing stout with claws. The background is out-of-focus gravel/asphalt.

The tail is completely occluded by the rear right limb and the angle of the carapace. It is impossible to verify.
